findings: All 15 current fixtures passed independent result checks in both processes. Baseline failed six fixtures in both processes; its exit code 1 is retained and expected.
Nonuniform-knot area: baseline 1.0010010010009915 instead of 101; current exactly 101 in the recorded runs.
Radius-5 height-7 rational cylinder area at steps=32: baseline 220.06284436420052 instead of 70*pi=219.9114857512855; current 219.91148573036673.

The 32-by-32 control planar area workload exposes a performance regression: about 128 ms current versus 5 ms baseline, while both return area 961. The new integral evaluates 841 native knot cells and the evaluator scans the full 1024-control grid at each sample.
Local B-spline support is a concrete optimization candidate. A safe implementation must retain derivative contributions when a basis value is zero, particularly at endpoints and internal knots.

The bounded geometric closed predicate costs about 1.25 to 2.01 microseconds for 64 to 8192 controls versus about 0.36 to 0.48 microseconds for the old derivative-speed predicate. The old predicate is wrong on the short-knot-span fixture.
Small bilinear area and orthogonal-plane closest timings improved on these measured inputs; no whole-application speed claim follows.

procedure: Create a private temporary directory with baseline/ and current/ subdirectories. Put isolated_wrapper_source into each lib.rs.

For each of curve_geometry.rs, surface_kernel.rs and surface_curvature.rs, use git show a1ffa40071c0c3508b890065bd12220c5abb80d9:src/FILE for baseline and git show 996d76defd61bc55ec6001ccb5dc2fdf67c98bd0:src/FILE for current. Verify the recorded SHA-256 source hashes before compiling.
Compile both lib.rs with rustc --crate-name morphlet --crate-type rlib and kernel_and_harness_rustc_flags. Store each libmorphlet.rlib separately.

Build a temporary JSON-support package with the recorded manifest and lib.rs containing pub use serde_json;. Use cargo generate-lockfile --offline followed by cargo build --offline --locked --message-format=json, with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0. This is harness output support, not a new project dependency.
Read compiler-artifact filenames from Cargo JSON and copy .rlib/.rmeta files to one temporary link directory; do not assume a Cargo target/debug/deps layout.

Compile the same examples/geometry_numeric_benchmark.rs twice using the recorded rustc flags, --extern morphlet=VERSION/libmorphlet.rlib, --extern serde_json=LINK/libserde_json-HASH.rlib and -L dependency=LINK.

Set NODES_SOURCE_SHA, NODES_RUSTC_VERSION, NODES_BUILD_FLAGS, NODES_BENCH_BUILD_SCOPE, NODES_BENCH_LABEL and NODES_BENCH_AFFINITY. Pin each process to the same permitted CPU (CPU 0 here) and run baseline,current,current,baseline serially. Preserve JSON even when baseline exits 1.
Pool the 22 batch means only for descriptive nearest-rank summaries. Report a timing ratio only when both versions pass the same independent result checks.

after_local_basis_recurrence.implementation: For recurrence degree d, evaluate indices span-d..=span; initialize and retain the original full-width output vectors. The final first derivative loop similarly writes span-p..=span. Span selection, active arithmetic order and denominator checks are unchanged.
after_local_basis_recurrence.support_argument: The degree-zero seed is nonzero only at span s. Recurrences reference entries i and i+1, so each degree extends the support at most one position left, giving [s-d,s]. Since s>=p>=d and next.len()=n+p-d>=n>s, all accessed indices remain valid.
